trigger.description: Operator enabled `[search.lexical_ram_tier] enabled = true` on a macOS host. macOS exposes `madvise(MADV_WILLNEED)` + `mlock` but no transparent-hugepage API, so the Linux-equivalent pinning shape cannot be reproduced; the optimization remains experimental on the Mac dev path while the production target stays Linux 256GB+ hosts (bd-21xbi parent). The Mac arm emits this code instead of the generic `lexical_ram_tier_not_implemented` so operators can distinguish 'wrong host class for this optimization' from 'Linux adapter slice has not landed yet'.

expected_emission.repair_string: Run ee on a Linux 256GB+ host to opt into lexical posting-list RAM-tier pinning; macOS keeps the optimization as an explicit no-op while the bd-21xbi.2 Linux mmap+mlock+madvise adapter ships under the unsafe-policy escape hatch.
